source: Office for National Statistics, Births in England and Wales: 2025, dataset "Parents' country of birth", 2025 edition, released 27 May 2026. Table 6a: Live births by country of birth of mother and area of usual residence, 2025.
measure: Live births registered in 2025, by the mother's area of usual residence and the mother's country of birth as recorded at registration.
caveat: Mother's country of birth is reported in regional groups at local authority level; individual countries are published for England and Wales only. EU is the whole European Union as constituted in 2020, and NewEU is a subset of it, so EU, RestOfEurope_nonEU, Africa, MiddleEastAndAsia and RestOfWorld sum to the non-UK-born total. Geography mixes Country, Region, County, Unitary Authority, Metropolitan District, Non-metropolitan District and London Borough rows in one file, so filter on geographyType when joining. Births are a flow in one year, not a count of residents.
